name: Herm's Inn (Logan, UT) "Inside-Out" Grilled Cheese (Diners, Drive-Ins & Dives Warning)
searchKeywords: herms inn inside out grilled cheese
whyItWorks: Featured on Food Network's Triple D! Crispy grilled cheese exterior crust, but stuffed with black bean skins, garlic guacamole, and spicy sriracha. High gas/acid risk.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: avoid in active flares. If ordering in remission, ask for no sriracha and hold black beans to convert it into a pure cheese melt.
watchOuts: Whole black bean skins and spicy sriracha cause cramping and gas
Exterior cheese crust is very greasy
